definitions.explanation: Considering something as a whole rather than focusing on individual parts. Used when making general assessments or describing broad tendencies.

examples.japanese: {全体的|ぜんたいてき}に{良|よ}くできている。
{全体的|ぜんたいてき}な{印象|いんしょう}はとても{良|よ}かった。
examples.english: The overall impression was very good.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げは{全体的|ぜんたいてき}に{見|み}ると{増加|ぞうか}{傾向|けいこう}にある。
examples.english: Looking at sales overall, they are on an upward trend.

notes:
Very common in assessments, reviews, and summaries.

FORMS:
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}な + noun (modifier: overall ~)
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}に (adverbial: overall, on the whole)
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}に{見|み}ると (looking at it overall)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}な{印象|いんしょう} (overall impression)
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}な{傾向|けいこう} (general tendency)
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}な{評価|ひょうか} (overall evaluation)
- {全体的|ぜんたいてき}なバランス (overall balance)

The adverbial form {全体的|ぜんたいてき}に is especially frequent, used like English "overall" or "generally."
